referenceArtifactVerification.policy: The persisted 25-image original corpus was restored from the already verified PR artifact and every file SHA-256 was recomputed before commit.

verificationStatus.byteLevelValidation: scripts/validate-data-release.mjs recomputes SHA-256 for every persisted original and crop

dataLayerPolicy.dataDirectory: Consumable machine-readable release data and model-facing metadata.
dataLayerPolicy.datasetDirectory: Source acquisition, provenance, permissions, schemas, registries, and research-control records.
dataLayerPolicy.typescriptSources: The reviewed application catalog is canonical. The deterministic exporter materializes all 54 catalog profiles as standalone JSON plus aggregate JSON, JSONL and CSV, and regenerates the diagnostic index from that same catalog.
dataLayerPolicy.sourceErrata: Known source errata are normalized at the catalog boundary so the app and downloadable release cannot disagree on corrected DOI or publication metadata.
dataLayerPolicy.referenceBinaries: All 25 currently approved rights-cleared original references are persisted under images/reference/original with SHA-256, perceptual hash, dimensions, license, attribution and source provenance.
dataLayerPolicy.referenceCrops: Sixty-six reference panel derivatives are persisted under images/reference/crops. Twelve were manually bounded and fifty-four were expanded from reviewed scientific grid geometry. Every crop retains parent/source-group linkage, hashes, diagnosis or treatment context and trainingEligible=false.
dataLayerPolicy.trainingGate: Reference evidence is not model ground truth. Supervised Cannabis training stays blocked until independently reviewed samples satisfy rights, confirmation, source-group, duplicate and coverage requirements.

limitations: This 54-profile expansion is a release candidate until pull-request export, validator, source-quality tests and clean-room read-back all pass.
The 91 source-controlled images remain a reference corpus, not a statistically sufficient supervised Cannabis training corpus.
No current sample is marked trainingEligible, so Cannabis-only train/validation/test/holdout splits remain intentionally empty and blocked.
Several new disease classes require culture, microscopy, molecular testing or analytical measurements for high-confidence confirmation; their photo-only confidence caps are deliberately conservative.
Copyright-restricted or rights-unknown institutional images remain excluded from the public training layer.
External plant-disease datasets are registered only for transfer learning and robustness work; they are not Cannabis ground truth.
